content: Samar Ghosh called Sunita Agarwal to clarify claim paperwork requirements. Sunita confirmed that a clear scanned copy of the proof of payment is acceptable and that all documents, including cabinet photos under 5 MB, can be uploaded through the portal's Claims Upload section. Additionally, Samar inquired about the billing cycle, and Sunita informed him that the next premium due date and auto-debit will occur on 15 October 2026. Samar stated he would compile and upload the documents today.

action_items: Samar to compile documents and upload them through the portal today
